brand.subtitle: Urubuga rw'ubukode
brand.tagline: Urubuga rwizewe mu Rwanda ruhuza ba nyir'inzu n'abapangayi.

login.title: Injira
login.description: Murakaza neza nanone. Injiza amakuru yawe kugira ngo ugere kuri konti yawe.
login.googleComingSoonTooltip: Kwinjira ukoresheje Google bizafungurwa igihe uburyo bwo kwinjira buzaba bwahujwe na sisitemu.

details.description: Injiza amazina yawe n'imeri yawe kugira ngo utangire.
details.inviteDescription: Emeza amakuru yawe kugira ngo winjire mu mwanya w'ubukode wa nyir'inzu.

identification.label: Umwirondoro
identification.title: Emeza umwirondoro wawe
identification.description: Ongeramo nimero ya telefoni n'indangamuntu kugira ngo wuzuze amakuru yawe.

photo.label: Ifoto

photo.description: Ongeramo ifoto kugira ngo konti yawe igaragare neza, cyangwa usimbuke iyi ntambwe ubu.

validation.fullNameMin: Amazina yose agomba kuba afite byibuze inyuguti 2.
validation.telephoneRequired: Nyamuneka injiza nimero ya telefoni yawe.

photo.label: Ifoto ya konti
photo.unsupportedHint: Nyamuneka shyira hano ifoto yemewe (JPG, PNG, cyangwa WebP).
photo.browseHint: Kurura ushyire hano, cyangwa ukande uhitemo dosiye
photo.description: JPG, PNG, cyangwa WebP. Ushobora gusimbuka iyi ntambwe ukayongera nyuma.
photo.invalidFile: Nyamuneka hitamo ifoto imwe yemewe (JPG, PNG, cyangwa WebP).

invite.heading: Ubutumire bwa nyir'inzu bwabonetse ({code})
invite.fallbackDescription: Uzuza amakuru yawe hasi kugira ngo urebe imbonerahamwe yawe y'umupangayi.
invite.previewNote: Iyi ni incamake y'ubutumire — igenzura ryuzuye rya kode rizakorwa igihe sisitemu izaba yahujwe.

preview.renterNotice: Kwiyandikisha kuri seriveri ntibirahuzwa. Amakuru yawe y'umupangayi yabitswe kuri iki gikoresho kugira ngo ugerageze.
preview.landlordNotice: Kwiyandikisha kuri seriveri ntibirahuzwa. Amakuru yawe ya nyir'inzu yabitswe kuri iki gikoresho kugira ngo ugerageze — guhitamo serivisi bizakorwa igihe uzinjira bwa mbere.

email.title: Wibagiwe ijambobanga?
email.description: Injiza imeri yawe maze tukohereze kode yo kwemeza kugira ngo uhindure ijambobanga ryawe.

code.title: Reba muri imeri yawe
code.description: Niba hari konti ihuje n'iyi meri, twohereje kode yo kwemeza. Yinjize hasi kugira ngo ukomeze.

password.title: Shyiraho ijambobanga rishya
password.description: Hitamo ijambobanga rishya rikomeye kandi uryemeze hasi.

success.title: Ijambobanga ryahinduwe
success.description: Ijambobanga ryawe ryahinduwe. Ubu ushobora kwinjira ukoresheje ijambobanga ryawe rishya.

fields.codePlaceholder: Injiza kode yoherejwe muri imeri yawe

validation.passwordMin: Ijambobanga rigomba kuba rifite byibuze inyuguti 8.

errors.unavailable: Guhindura ijambobanga ntibiratangira gukora. Nyamuneka ongera ugerageze nyuma.
errors.requestFailed: Ntibyakunze kurangiza ubusabe bwawe. Nyamuneka ongera ugerageze.
errors.verifyFailed: Ntibyakunze kwemeza iyo kode. Yisuzume wongere ugerageze, cyangwa usabe indi nshya.
errors.resetFailed: Ntibyakunze guhindura ijambobanga ryawe. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa utangire bushya.

notices.codeResent: Niba hari konti ihuje n'iyi meri, kode nshya yo kwemeza yoherejwe.
